label: Arc 8 was rebuilt too
from: Pandora becomes flesh under a shooting star, plus the rest
to: The Pandora and Jade beats moved to Arc 6; the arc keeps its name
note: Arc 6 reached forward and pulled the big Pandora and Jade beats out of BOTH Arc 7 and Arc 8, because Pandora asked to be embodied early. Roughly three minor arcs were left standing. Arc 8 KEEPS ITS NAME because the name is important: Ghost Flesh is now Atlas and Leviathan resurfacing and the Surviving Hounds, and Forgotten Names is Siren's sister and Livi's notebook. The title survived the amputation and got more accurate.
